    Complementarity of primitive new-mesh markers #

    For a primitive new right mesh, this file proves that the deleted simple is a quotient of the ambient left marker exactly when it is not a subobject of the ambient right marker. The proof uses the Hoshino torsion sequence and stable Auslander--Reiten duality directly.
